confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of local price levels, not checked against current menus, listings or live bookings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable; July hostel and hotel rates are the most volatile. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor. Euro prices assume a EUR/USD rate of about 1.16. FX: the latest RBA figure I could confirm is 14 Oct 2026, taken from a search-result snippet of the RBA homepage; no 15 Oct figure was found in the sources reached.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Porto and other southern European capitals with similar summer tourist demand; restaurant and café anchors use local tasca, café and bar price levels rather than tourist-core prices.
